career_overview.short_description: Build the server-side logic, databases, and APIs that power modern web and mobile applications.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain robust server-side APIs
Model relational and document data with appropriate constraints and indexing
Implement secure authentication, session management, and authorization
Integrate third-party services, background jobs, and caching mechanisms
Write automated unit and integration tests for backend services
representative_work: A fully functional REST API with authentication, relational database storage, background processing, and comprehensive unit tests.
core_skills: RESTful API design and status codes
Relational database schemas and SQL queries
API request validation and error handling

roadmap.title: Backend Developer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: A fully functional REST API with authentication, relational database storage, background processing, and comprehensive unit tests.
